requirement_text: The system shall manage and coordinate the flights of multiple unmanned aerial systems.
The system shall monitor and control drone operations in real-time.
The system shall support high-fidelity simulation of unmanned aerial systems.
The system shall integrate both simulated and physical drone environments.
The system shall ensure safe operation of drones to prevent collisions and accidents.
The system shall provide runtime monitoring capabilities for drone operations.
The system shall support flight planning and route management.
The system shall provide traceability between system artifacts such as requirements, design, and code.
The system shall support safety assurance through hazard analysis and risk mitigation.
The system shall allow researchers to experiment with different system configurations and features.
The system shall provide real-time information about drone position.
The system shall generate alerts in case of system failures.
The drone shall land safely when system failures are detected.
The drone shall provide warnings when approaching operational limits.
The drone shall support automated safety functions during operation.
